This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

Abba, Father, Thou in love Hast embraced us in Thy bosom. Thy children here are gathered In the name of our Lord Jesus. Thou Thyself hast chosen us as sons In Thy great fatherly love, Taught us to cry, "Abba, Father," Brought us where Thou Thyself dost dwell.

2.

God our Father, we Thee praise, Thou hast given Thy Son, And in Him all Thy love Now hath been made manifest. Thy righteousness He hath proclaimed, All Thy wisdom, power, and grace; As Father He hath declared Thee, And announced to us Thy counsel.

3.

Abba, Father, we adore Thee, While angelic hosts Now in us behold Thy wisdom, Learn what Thy love is. Soon gathered forever, We shall praise in heaven’s haven Abba’s love, known in Jesus, And His precious Father-name.

Text: Efter Abba, Father, we approach Thee av James G. Deck, 1841. Musik: Brightly beams our Father’s mercy av Philip P. Bliss, 1871. 8.7.8.7 D
